blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — They say our parents are usually our first teachers. Lucky for me, my mom actually is one. My mother was a teacher (or still is… I mean, one may retire, but do they ever really stop teaching?). It was a running joke in the family that her dad, my lolo, did everything he could to stop my mom from becoming one. Teaching is one of the most fulfilling and noble professions.
